title: Server-side control flow inside unified storage
answers: How does a write or read RPC get handled on the unified storage server side?
Where do writes vs search/reads diverge in unified storage?
What wires up the unified storage gRPC service?
body: pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:type server implements the RPCs (Create, Update, Delete, Read, List, Watch, Search - around lines 1095,1223,1320,1436,1613,2007). Writes go through the StorageBackend interface (server.go:176), implemented by the legacy SQL backend pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go (being retired) or the newer KV backend pkg/storage/unified/resource/kv.go. Search/reads go through pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go, fed by resource/document.go and kept in sync via resource/notifier*.go. Everything is wired up in pkg/storage/unified/sql/service.go:ProvideUnifiedStorageGrpcService.
